blends.name: Dicey Deadly: Fanflow
blends.desc:
#### Will you risk a forced powerup? The Unaxx might not survive... 

There is a 50% chance at a deadly card and a 50% chance at a Fragment.

Fragments are a failed attempt at trying to upgrade your Unaxx. 2 Fragments + 1 Sticker will allow you to blend into 1 Matching Unaxx Card.
*Example: You have 2 Fragment of Luga and 1 Luga sticker,  you are then able to blend those into a Legendary Luga Battle Card. Silver stickers and above does not work.*

Find Stickers here: [Stickers](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=unaxxtrdcrds&order=asc&schema_name=stickers&sort=price&symbol=WAX)
